verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Grafana Alerting sends notifications to named integrations such as Slack, PagerDuty, VictorOps and OpsGenie. Those are chat or incident-tool integrations, not documented, registrable outbound HTTP webhooks that an automated remediation system or agent could receive. Nothing in the pack documents a generic webhook contact point, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point alert notifications at webhooks that trigger automated remediation or agents
